verdict.headline: The result survives correction for the search that produced it.
reasons: The search ran 316 trials, which lifts the bar a winner has to clear from a Sharpe of 0 to a Sharpe of 0.29.
The observed Sharpe of 0.53 deflates to a 99% probability that the true Sharpe is above that bar.
At this Sharpe and these higher moments, 48.5 years of track record would be needed to clear the bar at 95 percent confidence.

published.n_trials_source: Harvey, Liu and Zhu (2016) count 316 published factors. A factor taken from the literature carries the literature's search burden, even though only one trial was run here.
